question: Which range of worlds is governed by the Kālāhāṭaka lords?
premises: A range of worlds is specified.
That range ends with the world of truth.
inference: Therefore the Kālāhāṭaka lords govern the worlds from hell up to the world of truth.
plain_english: The range from hell up to the world of truth is governed by the Kālāhāṭaka lords.
